speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I see you have a chronic wound on your right lower leg. To understand the cause, how long has this wound been present, and have you noticed any changes in its size, color, or drainage?

speaker: Patient
text: 57-year-old male. The patient reports a large wound on his right lower leg that has been present for 6 months. He mentions that his legs have been chronically swollen for over 10 years and that his mother and brother had similar leg problems. He had a documented deep vein thrombosis (DVT) in the affected leg 5 years ago but has no other significant past medical history.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Venous Insufficiency with associated venous leg ulcers.

Given your history of DVT, long-term swelling, and the family history suggesting venous insufficiency, I need to confirm the extent of the skin changes and rule out infection before we finalize the treatment plan. REQUEST IMAGES: Please provide photos of the right lower leg wound and the surrounding skin, noting any redness, warmth, or foul odor. REQUEST TEST: Wound_Culture.
